description: This PHP source file defines a class 'MyReviewMenuConfigurator' which implements the 'MenuConfigurator' interface. The class uses a trait and contains a method 'configure' that overrides the screen to 'myPerformanceReview' in a Human Resource Management plugin related to performance reviews.

classes.name: MyReviewMenuConfigurator
classes.description: A class that configures menu items for performance reviews in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the current screen to 'myPerformanceReview' for the performance menu and returns null.
